purpose: Enable the dedicated one-probe fast matcher without undefined unaligned C accesses.
Use byte pointers with two-byte strides and forced-inline bytewise little-endian reads.
Store exactly two distance bytes in the three-byte LZ token.
Keep the safe path active under UBSan; unused common LE macros remain bytewise.
configuration: ../../miniz_config.h selects this path; capture-sd builder retains -Os and adds -mno-unaligned-access.
default_upstream_record: UPSTREAM.json retains original downloaded hashes; it is not rewritten to label patched files upstream.
